notes: ACCESS: Tier (a) direct HTTP fetch (curl with a real-browser User-Agent) worked fully - robots.txt (User-agent: *) does not block /collections/*, only cart/checkout/account/search/policies/sort/filter combos; all pages returned HTTP 200 with server-rendered HTML (Shopify theme), so Playwright/CDP was not needed. TREE: built the union of (1) the two header mega-menu blocks (GARTEN, DEKO & WOHNEN, TISCH & KUeCHE, INSPIRATION, SALE, NEU) parsed from the homepage HTML, and (2) the full /sitemap_collections_1.xml listing (171 collection URLs), which surfaced two extra genuine table-linen nodes (wachstischdecken, picknickdecken) not present in the mega-menu. Each candidate leaf was fetched individually and its h1/canonical was checked against the requested slug before recording. QTY: taken from the collection page's '#ProductCount' status text - either an exact 'N Produkte' or, for paginated pages, the total from 'X von Y Produkten' (Y used). Picknickdecken shows the site's own empty-state message 'Diese Kategorie enthaelt derzeit keine Produkte.' (this category currently contains no products), recorded as qty=0 per the zero-product-category rule. EXCLUDED - seasonal/mixed catch-all collections: 'accessoires' (353 products, generic site-wide accessories dump), 'weihnachts-tischwaesche' (66 products, a seasonal cross-collection duplicating products already counted individually under Tischdecken/Tischlaeufer/Tischsets/Servietten/Wachstischdecken), 'tischdeko-weihnachten' and 'outdoor-dining' (curated lifestyle/shop-the-look collections mixing Kitchen&Dining, Furniture and decor, not a dedicated Textile/Storage node), 'bad-accessoires' (36 products, a generic bath-accessories catch-all - predominantly soap dispensers/dishes, toothbrush cups, cosmetic bags, decorative trays; the few storage tins and a shower curtain/bath mat inside it are already reachable via their own dedicated collections or have no dedicated URL of their own, so the mixed parent node itself was not recorded). EXCLUDED - non-textile/non-storage nodes: 'Waermflaschen & Handwaermer' (hot-water bottles/hand warmers - primary product is a functional heating item, not a home textile, even though some have knit covers); 'Untersetzer' (coasters - not in the Table Textiles list, materials on-page are marble/stone/felt-composite, primary product type is a hard-surface protector, not fabric); 'Muelleimer' (trash bins - waste receptacle, not a storage/organization product per storage.md); 'Koerbe' (Baskets, 8 products under Wohnaccessoires) - checked individual product pages: mixed bag of a Steinzeug/stoneware decorative bowl-basket, two carry/tote bags, one Halloween novelty basket, and only one genuine 'STORE IT' polyester storage-basket set, so the node reads as a decorative-accessories collection rather than a genuine storage category and was excluded per storage.md Sec.5/Sec.23 (decorative basket with no uniform storage function, classified per its actual - non-storage - website hierarchy, parent 'Wohnaccessoires'); Vasen, Kerzen/Kerzenhalter/Laternen/Windlichter/Teelichthalter, Raumduefte/Diffuser, Blumen/Kunstpflanzen/Blumentoepfe, Geschirr/Glaeser/Besteck/Kuechenutensilien/Schneidebretter/Tabletts, Lampen family, Gartenmoebel/Balkonmoebel/Gartentische/Gartenstuehle/Sonnenschirme, Badmoebel/Moebel (Furniture), Gartendeko/Gartenbeleuchtung/Pflanzgefaesse, and all seasonal/gift/promo collections (Neu, Bestseller, Halloween, Peanuts, Spring Picnic, Brunch & Breakfast, Garden BBQ, Cocktail Party, Geschenkideen, Sale, and the Christmas-themed collections) - none are Textile or Storage per the rule files. Duplicate handling: 'Handtuecher' (Towels) is linked from both the Wohntextilien menu and the Bad & Wellness menu to the same /collections/handtuecher URL - recorded once, under Wohntextilien. 'Duschvorhaenge' (Shower Curtains) and 'Outdoortextilien' (Outdoor Textiles) sit in mixed non-textile menu branches (Bad & Wellness, Garten) that otherwise contain only furniture/decor/lighting, so no artificial parent grouping row was invented for them - recorded as standalone Textile leaves, consistent with 'do not emit an orphaned parent' for branches that are not genuinely textile/storage groupings. Same treatment applied to 'Geschirrhandtuecher' (Dish Towels) on the Textile side, whose direct parent 'Kuechenhelfer & Aufbewahrung' is recorded as a Storage grouping row instead (since its own genuine Storage leaf, Dosen & Vorratsglaeser, sits directly under it).
